page.layout: One text column, full width; in the left margin, beside the paragraphs of the column, three small section numbers (1, 2, 3). Running head at top; printed page number at top left; catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: I. Quidam existimarunt elementa esse infinita, in quibus Anaxagoras censuit infinita esse elementa, eademq; corpora ὁμοιόμερα, id est, habentia similes partes. Sed reprobatur hæc opinio.
1.Primo : Palàm aduertimus, multa corpora esse ὁμοιόμερα, necnon in partes similes resoluì: cuius generis sunt caro, os, lignum. Hæc uero ipsa non sunt elementa.

2.Secundo : Etiamsi elementa essent eiusmodi, tamen ne propterea quidem opus foret infinita constituere. Etenim uniuersa elementorum natura rectius explicari potest, si ponantur finita, quàm si ponantur infinita. Siquidem infinitorum non potest haberi certa cognitio. Estq; communis omnium philosophorum sententia, Principia debere esse finita aut quantitate, aut specie.

3.Tertio : Vnuquodq; corpus distinguitur ab alio secundum proprias eius differentias. Atqui elementorum differentiæ, quæ sunt primæ qualitates sensibiles, sunt finitæ. Ergo oportet ipsa quoque elementa finita existere.

II. Democritus & Leucippus definierunt, magnitudines esse prima corporum elementa, atq; illas quidem multitudine infinitas, magnitudine uero in-diuisibiles: ideoq; ex uno non fieri multa, neque ex multis fieri unum: sed omnium magnitudinum mutua inter se complectione produci omnia, eademq;

page.notes: Printed spellings kept as they stand: "Palàm", "imdiuisibiles" read as in-diuisibiles with a printed hyphen at the line end. The Greek ὁμοιόμερα is read from the scan and may be inexact; the accent and final letters are doubtful. The page's paragraph numbers I., II. and the sidenotes 1., 2., 3. are printed as shown. The u/v and i/j normalisation was applied throughout (e.g. Unuquodq;, uniuersa as universa, divisibiles). Long s was written as plain s.
